# Captain Saul

## Overview

- **Age:** 76 years old  <sub>[v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028), [v4 c40 P0](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Lighthouse keeper and former sea captain  <sub>[v4 c6 P18](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0018), [v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), [v4 c9 P24](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0024)</sub>
- **Titles:** Captain  <sub>[v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Captain Saul  <sub>[v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

He was a tall, plain-looking, slightly stooped man with a rough, bronzed, and heavily furrowed face, thin jaws, a rough mouth, a broad forehead, and an iron-gray mane of hair that hung to his shoulders. His deep-set, blue eyes had a yearning look or a twinkle. In his old age, he grew stooped and frail, with whitening hair and trembling hands.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c6 P15](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0015), [v4 c30 P3](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0003), [v4 c30 P11](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0011), [v4 c35 P37](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0037)_

## Personality

Captain Saul was a pure-hearted, cheerful, and uncommonly polite man who treated women with high respect and held deep reverence for beauty in nature and art. A simple-minded, heroic soul, he had great endurance and courage, remaining calm even under provocation. He was extremely generous and kind to children, animals, and neighbors, though he harbored an intense lifelong romantic memory.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P13](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0013), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c6 P23](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0023), [v4 c6 P27](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0027), [v4 c8 P61](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0061), [v4 c9 P3](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0003), [v4 c9 P4](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0004), [v4 c9 P5](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0005), [v4 c9 P48](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0048), [v4 c16 P8](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0008), [v4 c17 P16](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0016)_

## History

Captain Saul spent decades as a sea captain, experiencing wild adventures including mutinies, shipwrecks, and pirate encounters across the world before retiring to keep the lighthouse at Seven Gulls Point. When Nell Carrow and her husband arrived in Seven Gulls, he befriended them, sharing stories, tea, and companionship at both his lighthouse and their house of dreams. He maintained a strong friendship with Lorna Vane, assisting her with loans and advising that her long-lost husband be informed of his survival options. During a visit by Adrian Treleaven, the schoolmaster's grandson, Captain Saul shared his handwritten logbook, leading Adrian to adapt his life into a published novel. On the day his author's copy arrived, Captain Saul spent a joyous evening reading it, and passed away peacefully in his armchair that night with the book on his chest.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P10](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0010), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), [v4 c9 P4](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0004), [v4 c9 P48](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0048), [v4 c9 P50](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0050), [v4 c17 P16](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0016), [v4 c17 P19](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0019), [v4 c24 P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), [v4 c25 P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006), [v4 c30 P4](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0004), [v4 c30 P7](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0007), [v4 c31 P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 c39 P4](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0004), [v4 c39 P12](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0012), [v4 c39 P25](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0025), [v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)_

## Background by volume

- Spent his entire life at sea traveling the world until retiring five years prior  <sub>[v4 c8 P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)</sub>
- Lost his beloved, Margaret, over fifty years ago when her dory drifted out to sea during a storm  <sub>[v4 c20 P16](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0016)</sub>
- Was close friends with the original schoolmaster and witnessed the arrival of the schoolmaster's bride sixty years ago  <sub>[v4 c7 P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 c7 P41](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0041), [v4 c25 P7](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0007)</sub>
- Discovered Rufus Vane in a Havana boarding house with his memory gone and brought him back  <sub>[v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033)</sub>
